checks.check: nothing owed or waiting at the end
a job's events keep its root

. as $e | [.[] | select(.type == "job.ended" and (.body.reason | IN("gave-up", "died"))) | .job as $j | $e[] | select(.type == "job.assigned" and .job == $j) | .agent] as $bad | all(.[] | select(.type == "job.dispatched" and .body.delivery == "hot"); .body.hot_agent | IN($bad[]) | not)
